title: Is the Onchain Rally Overheating? AMC vs. Meme Stocks & Hunter Biden’s LAPTOP
summary: In this episode of Galaxy Grid, the hosts assess if the onchain rally is overheating amidst Bitcoin's $80,000 consolidation and Zcash's 40% surge on renewed privacy narratives. They unpack the 4,000 BTC Liquid Network exploit, where attackers leveraged a software bug to drain funds before returning the majority of the haul. The hosts then dive into Robinhood chain drama, analyzing AMC CEO Adam Aron’s public cease-and-desist over tokenized stock pairs and the technical fallout from a brief data-posting disruption. Finally, they examine the intense backlash surrounding Hunter Biden’s reported "LAPTOP" token launch on Base, questioning whether celebrity meme coins signal a local market top.
